description: DB integration: create private + shared views as user A; listListViews as user B returns only the shared view; getListView(B, A's private id) returns not-found identical to a random id.
DB integration: createListView with visibility=shared without list_view:share is rejected; with permission succeeds.
DB integration: duplicate name (case-insensitive) for same owner+list is rejected; same name for different owner or different list succeeds.
DB integration: updateListView by non-owner on a shared view fails without list_view:manage and succeeds with it; non-owner can never update a private view.
DB integration: deleteListView clears user_preferences defaults pointing at it for all users; setMyDefaultListView rejects a view not visible to the caller.
DB integration: settings failing adapter schema (unknown key / bad sort direction) and unknown list_key are rejected.
DB integration: hard-deleting a user removes their private views and reassigns shared views to the acting admin.
Unit: DataTable honors controlled columnSizing/columnVisibility/columnOrder and falls back to localStorage sizing when uncontrolled.
Unit: useListViews resolution order (?view= → user default → baseline), dirty detection, discard, inaccessible-id fallback, and migrate on older schema_version.
Unit: tickets adapter capture→apply round-trip preserves board scope, filters, sort, columns, density, page size; excludes searchQuery; sanitize drops deleted refs and reports them.
Unit: projects, clients, contacts, assets adapters capture→apply round-trip and differs() detection.
UI (component): ListViewPicker renders sections/owner/star, footer enablement by dirty+canEdit, Shared option disabled without share permission, delete confirmation.

E2E Tickets: save private view with filters+hidden column on a board, reload with ?view= restores it incl. board tab; modify → dirty dot → save changes; set as default and reopen /msp/tickets applies it; board default save/reset still works.
E2E Assets (representative non-ticket list): user A saves shared view; user B sees it under Shared views and applies it; user B cannot edit it.
Translation validation passes (validate-translations.cjs) with new listViews.* keys in all locales.
